title: All product brochure — Contour spread

location.series: Cox Brand Collection — Lindsay Little / Periscope

slide_intent: Separate the emotional introduction from product detail so readers can scan at more than one depth.
strategic_value: A consistent image, type and gradient hierarchy can make Cox’s Contour offer feel familiar while explaining its options.
demonstration: An angled brochure spread combines a couple watching television, a room with a TV, feature copy, device images and a blue-purple offer panel.
practical_value: Reserve the largest images for use context and group detailed features into clearly differentiated text blocks.

content_islands.name: Left-page story
content_islands.spec: Place the couple photograph above feature descriptions and device imagery, with a small gradient Contour panel overlapping the photo.

content_islands.name: Right-page offer
content_islands.spec: Pair the room and TV image with a short introduction and a larger gradient package panel near the lower outer corner.
